technology.text: rectangular straw bale for construction as prepared at farm/plant and to be further used in building sites with straw ball walls

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data from farmers in Switzerland using specific machines/engines for parallelepipedic baling. 2 kinds of baling were takien into account, a small size baling (approx. 100*45*40cm) and a large size baling (250*80*90cm).
